Block.description: One region of print on a page, its box and the words read in it, belonging to one content item, or to no item when it is a section heading.

bbox.description: The region's box on the page picture: left, top, width and height, in the picture's pixels.

confidence.description: How sure the reading is, from 0 to 1, where it was recorded.

id.description: The region's id, such as blk-2001-02-03-p4-r001 or blk-abcd-2001-02-03-p4-r001.

image_crop.description: A picture of the region alone, by its path, where one was made.

transcription.description: The words read in the region, its lines separated by line breaks.

unit_id.description: The content item the region belongs to, by its id; null for a region that is a section's heading.

Block.title: Block

Page.description: One printed page of the issue: its picture, its size and its regions of print.

blocks.description: The regions of print on the page.

dimensions.description: The picture's width and height, in its pixels.

id.description: The page's id, such as page-1938-12-16-4.

image_service.description: The base URI of the holder's IIIF Image API 3 service for this page's picture, without /info.json or a trailing slash. It is the holder's service, never ours; image_uri remains the picture shown on the page. A manifest may attach this service to that image so viewers can request further sizes and regions.

image_uri.description: The page's picture, by its name or address.

issue_date.description: The date of the issue the page belongs to, written YYYY-MM-DD.

newspaper.description: The paper this page belongs to, by its id in the source register.

page_number.description: The page's number within the issue, from 1.

picture_source.description: The picture's credit when it differs from the paper's catalog entry. Absence means to use that entry; a present credit supplies its own holder and any route, shelf mark, link and rights, rather than merging individual fields.

Page.title: Page

PagesData.description: One issue's pages document: the issue's date and its pages in order.
PagesData.title: PagesData

PictureSource.description: The credit for pictures made from a holding: its holder's name, a separate access service or collection, the shelf mark and a link. Shared by a newspaper's default credit and a page whose picture comes from elsewhere.

holder.description: The name of the institution holding the pages the pictures were made from.

holder_url.description: The web address of the institution named in holder: its page for the holding where the source register has one, otherwise its home page.

rights.description: The rights statement for the pictures, as text.

rights_url.description: The address where the rights statement was read.

route.description: The name of the service or collection readers reach the pages through, when it differs from the holder itself.

shelf_mark.description: The holder's shelf mark or call number for the pages.

url.description: The pages' descriptive page at the holder or access route.

PictureSource.title: PictureSource
